description: Replace the native prompt() that captures a marking note in src/components/functions/MapsView/PruningMap.vue with an accessible Vuetify modal (modeled on the existing importCsvMode v-dialog), keeping all marker/icon/persistence/state logic byte-for-byte identical. Independent of FEAT-001 (disjoint file).
steps: In PruningMap.vue setup(), add reactive state near the other map refs: noteDialog = ref(false), noteText = ref(''), and a non-reactive-or-ref holder pendingMarkLatLng (e.g. let pendingMarkLatLng: L.LatLng | null = null) for the latlng of the pending click.

Extract the current marker-creation block (the code from `const marker = L.marker(...)` through the `markedLocations.value.push({...})` and the final `notify('📌 Marcação adicionada!', 'info')`) VERBATIM into a function createMarkingAt(latlng: L.LatLng, notes: string) so the L.marker, createMarkIcon(), bindPopup HTML, markedMarkersLayer.addLayer, openPopup, markedLocations.value.push and notify calls are unchanged in behavior.

In the map.on('click') handler, keep the simulation-mode branch and the `if (!markMode.value) return` guard untouched. Replace the prompt()/notes===null block so that when in markMode it stores ev.latlng into pendingMarkLatLng, sets noteText.value = '', and opens noteDialog.value = true. Do NOT create any marker in the click handler anymore.

Add confirmMarking(): if pendingMarkLatLng is set, call createMarkingAt(pendingMarkLatLng, noteText.value) (equivalent to the old notes != null path), then set noteDialog.value = false and pendingMarkLatLng = null. Add cancelMarking(): set noteDialog.value = false and pendingMarkLatLng = null without creating a marker (equivalent to old notes === null path).
Add noteDialog, noteText, confirmMarking, cancelMarking to the object returned from setup() so the template can bind them.

In the template, add a <v-dialog v-model="noteDialog" max-width="400"> modeled on the existing importCsvMode dialog: a v-card with title '📌 Nova marcação', a v-card-text containing a <v-text-field v-model="noteText" label="Nota da marcação" variant="outlined" autofocus @keyup.enter="confirmMarking" />, and v-card-actions with a spacer, a Cancelar button (@click="cancelMarking") and a Confirmar button (color consistent with app, @click="confirmMarking"). Rely on Vuetify's default Esc-to-close which triggers v-model false (treated as cancel).
acceptance_criteria: The native prompt() call for the marking note is removed from PruningMap.vue; note capture goes through the Vuetify v-dialog.

Marker creation logic is preserved: createMarkingAt contains the same L.marker/createMarkIcon/bindPopup/markedMarkersLayer.addLayer/markedLocations.push/notify sequence as before; markMode and toggleMarkMode are unchanged.
Confirm creates exactly one marking with the typed note; Cancel (and Esc/closing the dialog) creates no marking.
The note input receives autofocus and Enter confirms.
findings: Implemented in src/components/functions/MapsView/PruningMap.vue (disjoint from FEAT-001). Changes: (1) added setup refs noteDialog=ref(false), noteText=ref(''), and let pendingMarkLatLng: L.LatLng|null=null right after markMode; (2) extracted the former click-handler marker block VERBATIM into createMarkingAt(latlng: L.LatLng, notes: string) placed after removeMarkedLocation() (same L.marker/createMarkIcon/bindPopup HTML/markedMarkersLayer.addLayer/openPopup/markedLocations.push/notify('📌 Marcação adicionada!','info') sequence); (3) added confirmMarking() (creates marking from pendingMarkLatLng + noteText then closes dialog and clears pending) and cancelMarking() (closes + clears, no marker); (4) in map.on('click') the simulation branch and the `if (!markMode.value) return` guard are untouched; the prompt()/notes===null block is replaced by pendingMarkLatLng=ev.latlng; noteText.value=''; noteDialog.value=true (no marker created in the handler anymore); (5) added noteDialog, noteText, confirmMarking, cancelMarking to the setup() return; (6) added a <v-dialog v-model="noteDialog" max-width="400"> modeled on the importCsvMode dialog, with title '📌 Nova marcação', a v-text-field (v-model=noteText, label 'Nota da marcação', variant outlined, autofocus, @keyup.enter=confirmMarking) and v-card-actions with a spacer + Cancelar (@click=cancelMarking) + Confirmar (color deep-purple-darken-1, variant flat, @click=confirmMarking). Esc/close maps to v-model false which is treated as cancel (no marker). Verification: `npm run type-check` reports ONLY pre-existing errors in src/components/MainView/RegisterComponent.vue (FEAT-001's file); PruningMap.vue is clean. `npx vitest run` = 5 passed (2 files). `npm run lint:check` has repo-wide pre-existing errors; eslint on PruningMap.vue alone shows 31 problems both before and after this change (verified by git-stash comparison) so zero new lint errors were introduced. Note: the diff also contains a few behavior-neutral trailing-whitespace normalizations on nearby pre-existing lines. No git commit/push performed per instructions.
